opus.problem: Rhoda appears only in Acts 12:13-15, a single short scene. The Bible does not give 7 truly different facts about her, so the clues are thin slices of one moment. Clues 3, 4 and 5 all come from verse 14, and clues 6 and 7 both come from verse 15. The rules say to swap the word for a spare when there are not 7 different facts.
